function_app.name: func-jm1-fin-prod
function_app.endpoint_architecture: App Service frontend proxies /api/* to Azure Functions backend.

capacity_decision: No dedicated or premium capacity purchased; Linux Consumption was used.
platform_notes: Node 20 creation was rejected by Azure as end-of-life.
Node 24 Function sync was not stable in this region/runtime path.
Node 22 publish succeeded and discovered all five functions.
cors: Allowed origins include production apex, www, App Service default host, and localhost development origin.
security: Function routes remain anonymous where current SWA API was anonymous; runtime validates schemas, pilot allow-list, signed action tokens, and advisor authorization.
